name: Jerusalem
significance: Capital of ancient Israel and site of the Temple — the spiritual center of biblical history.

name: Bethlehem
significance: Birthplace of King David and of Jesus.

name: Nazareth
significance: The Galilean town where Jesus grew up and began his ministry.

name: Jericho
significance: Ancient walled city whose defeat opened Israel's conquest of Canaan.

name: Hebron
significance: Burial place of the patriarchs and David's first capital.

name: Mount Sinai
significance: The mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments.

name: Babylon
significance: Capital of the empire that exiled Judah; setting of Daniel and the prophets.

name: Egypt
significance: Land of bondage and refuge — setting of Joseph's rise and the Exodus.

name: Damascus
significance: Where Saul was struck blind on the road and converted to follow Christ.

name: Antioch
significance: The city where the followers of Jesus were first called Christians.

name: Corinth
significance: Roman trading city where Paul founded a major church and wrote letters back.

name: Rome
significance: Imperial capital and final destination of Paul's missionary journey.

name: Ur of the Chaldees
significance: Ancient Sumerian city — the birthplace of Abraham.

name: The Jordan River
significance: River where Israel crossed into the promised land and where Jesus was baptized.

name: Sea of Galilee
significance: The lake whose shores witnessed much of Jesus's teaching and miracles.
